---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, a new agent or an integration for Cold Open
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

### The problem

What is hard, slow or missing today? Who runs into it: the operator in Mission Control, or a business owner looking at a preview?

### The idea

What you would like Cold Open to do. If it is a new agent, say what it reads, what it writes, and where it sits in the pipeline.

### Alternatives you considered

Other ways to solve the same problem.

### Checklist

- [ ] Works with zero API keys, or degrades gracefully when its key is missing
- [ ] Keeps the preview contract: "Unofficial concept preview" banner, `noindex,nofollow`, Claim and Remove on every page
- [ ] Does not fabricate reviews, ratings, prices, metrics or facts about real businesses
- [ ] Needs no new npm dependency (or explains why one is worth it)
- [ ] Respects [docs/ETHICS.md](https://github.com/vnmoorthy/coldopen/blob/main/docs/ETHICS.md), including crawling and outreach rules

### Anything else

Links, sketches, prior art.
